en.headline: Court jails domestic helper five months for indecent assault
en.dek: Kowloon City Court sentenced a 45-year-old helper on three counts after convicting her of offences against her former employer’s daughter.
body: Kowloon City Court on Friday sentenced Lady Jay Santos Flores, 45, to five months in jail after she was convicted on three counts of indecent assault.

The court found she had molested her former employer’s 12-year-old daughter on several occasions in May and June 2025 at a flat in Kwun Tong. She was acquitted of a charge involving the child’s younger sister.
The magistrate cited the complainant’s age and the breach of trust as aggravating factors. Flores offered no mitigation and sobbed during the hearing.

zh.headline: 外傭非禮僱主女兒罪成 判囚五個月
zh.dek: 九龍城裁判法院周五判處一名45歲外傭三項非禮罪成，入獄五個月。
body: 九龍城裁判法院周五判處Lady Jay Santos Flores（45歲）三項非禮罪成，監禁五個月。
法院裁定她於2025年5月至6月間，在觀塘高怡邨單位多次非禮前僱主的12歲女兒。涉及較年幼女兒的控罪則獲判無罪。
裁判官指事主年紀及信任關係破裂屬加重因素。被告未作求情，聲訊期間一度噁泣。
